Unit prices to the state are considerably lower than to the general public because of quantity purchases and no payment of state sales or federal excise taxes. Vehicle purchase, assignment and use policies. The legislature's role in policy determination concerning state-owned vehicles has been confined almost exclusively to appropriating funds for vehicles.
